name: Celeste
source:
Once a forgotten side character doomed to die, the protagonist is reborn in her place. Now, as the Saintess of the Golden Bow, she must forge her own fate, wield divine power, and rise as the hero of her nation.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419240/Saintess_of_the_Golden_Bow/]Steam[/url]]
